name: svartalfar_warrior
description: a Svartalfar Warrior (Fall from Heaven), a dark elf: pale grey skin, long white hair, a long pointed ear and violet eyes, a black fur mantle over the shoulders, a purple tunic with a jagged hem, a brown leather belt, black leather armour on the arms and legs and black boots with silver bands, a heavy black wooden club studded with round silver studs raised in the RIGHT hand (screen-left), and a round black shield with a silver spiderweb pattern and a silver boss on the LEFT arm (screen-right)
hands: the studded club stays in the right hand on the screen-left side and the round spiderweb shield stays on the left arm on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the studded club is lifted beside the head with its heavy end pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the club hand behind the head and the studded club hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, the spiderweb shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the club arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the studded club is level, its heavy end pointing to the right
strike.4: contact: club arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the studded club smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the spiderweb shield arm swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the studded club carries on down until its heavy end nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, white hair trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the studded club comes back up on the near side toward its raised ready angle, the spiderweb shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (club arm thrown up and out to the left, the spiderweb shield flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the studded club dipping, the spiderweb shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, club arm flung up, the spiderweb shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the studded club lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the heavy end of the studded club resting on the ground at the lower-right, the shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the studded club slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, white hair flying
death.5: hits the ground: lying on the back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, white hair spread on the ground; the studded club lies on the ground at the lower-right; the spiderweb shield lies flat beside the body
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the spiderweb shield rocks
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on the back, eyes closed, the studded club and the spiderweb shield on the ground beside the body
